mapper.select:
select type as attackType, count (*) as times from situation_attack_message_history
attack_or_defense = 'attack'
and scene_id = #{sceneId}
group by type order by times desc

select defense_type, count (*) as times from situation_attack_message_history
attack_or_defense = 'defense' and scene_id = #{sceneId} and defense_type is not null
group by defense_type order by times desc

select resource_id, create_time as time, source_id ,target_id, type as attack_type from situation_attack_message_history
attack_or_defense = 'attack'
and scene_id = #{sceneId}
and type != 'media-animation'
order by create_time desc
